request.brief: Users can belong to multiple organizations. Within each org they may be a head user and may be granted specific clients. A Client Admin must never see or edit a System Admin. Assigned clients (what the admin ticked) are distinct from effective clients (derived access) - the UI must always render assigned.

guard.reason: Target localhost:8100 is a confirmed disposable backend (matched "localhost:810*").

findings.title: Proctor token can read /api/users/:id for a System Admin
findings.tierReason: Reproduced 3/3 cold by qa-triage-01; negative control on parent commit also failed, so this is pre-existing, not a regression introduced by the working tree.

oracle.quote: Proctor: No access to user/role management.

steps: Log in as qa-proctor@example.com via the API to obtain a session cookie.
GET /api/users/{id} on user-service (8102) with that cookie, using a System Admin id.
Observe HTTP 200 with the full user document.
findings.expected: 403 Forbidden - the Proctor role has no `users` permission at all.
findings.actual: 200 OK. Response body includes email, status, organizations[] and roleId of the System Admin.

findings.title: Org edit as Client Admin drops the user's other organizations
findings.tierReason: Reproduced 3/3 cold by qa-triage-02. Negative control on HEAD~1 passed, so the working tree introduced it.

oracle.quote: updateUser MERGES, never replaces, for non-System-Admins - out-of-scope orgs are preserved.

steps: Seed qa-multiorg-user assigned to Org A and Org B.
Log in as a Client Admin scoped to Org A only.
Open the user, change the client selection inside Org A, save.
Re-fetch the user as System Admin.
findings.expected: organizations[] still contains both Org A (updated) and Org B (untouched).
findings.actual: organizations[] contains only Org A. The Org B assignment is gone.

findings.title: Client multi-select overflows its container in Hebrew at 375px
findings.tierReason: Reproduced 3/3 cold at the same viewport and locale.

oracle.quote: The selected-client chips render outside the dialog bounds and are unclickable.

steps: Open Edit user and select three clients.
findings.expected: Chips wrap inside the dialog; all remain clickable.
findings.actual: Chips extend past the right edge of the dialog; the third is not hittable.

findings.title: Client Admin sees a System Admin row in the users table
findings.tierReason: Failed 2 of 3 cold runs. Suspected ordering dependency on the seeded fixture - filed as PLAUSIBLE, not CONFIRMED, pending a deterministic repro.

oracle.quote: Client Admins cannot view/edit/lock/park System Admins.

steps: Log in as a Client Admin.
Open /users and page through the list.
findings.expected: No System Admin rows are rendered.
findings.actual: The seeded System Admin appears on page 2 in 2 of 3 runs.

findings.title: Save button stays disabled after picking an organization
findings.tierReason: No oracle and no reproduction. qa-triage-02 could not reproduce from the artifacts (0/3); the original failure was a stale locator after the dialog re-rendered.
findings.expected: Save becomes enabled once an organization is selected.
findings.actual: Agent reported it stayed disabled; not reproducible.

truncation: adversarial, responsive-a11y, resilience and visual axes were not requested for this run.
i18n-rtl skipped 2 checks: locales 'cs' and 'sk' have no seeded org fixtures.
Only the first 25 users per page were inspected on /users.
